defmodule FileService.Router do
  use Plug.Router
  require Logger

  plug :match
  plug :dispatch

  @upload_dir "/var/data/uploads"
  @temp_dir "/tmp/file_service"

  defmodule Auth do
    # No insecure default: the HMAC key MUST be provided via configuration/environment.
    # Raises at compile time if missing to avoid using a predictable/hardcoded secret.
    @hmac_key Application.compile_env(:file_service, :hmac_key) ||
                raise("file_service :hmac_key must be configured (no default allowed)")

    def verify_service_token(token) do
      case String.split(token, ".", parts: 3) do
        [service_id, timestamp, signature] ->
          payload = "#{service_id}.#{timestamp}"
          expected = :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, @hmac_key, payload) |> Base.url_encode64(padding: false)

          case Integer.parse(timestamp) do
            {ts, ""} ->
              now = System.system_time(:second)
              cond do
                not secure_compare(signature, expected) -> {:error, :invalid_signature}
                now - ts > 300 -> {:error, :expired}
                true -> {:ok, service_id}
              end

            _ ->
              {:error, :malformed}
          end

        _ ->
          {:error, :malformed}
      end
    end

    defp secure_compare(a, b) when byte_size(a) == byte_size(b) do
      :crypto.hash_equals(a, b)
    end
    defp secure_compare(_, _), do: false
  end

  defmodule PathValidator do
    @doc "Validates that a path component is safe for use in file operations"
    def validate_filename(name) do
      cond do
        String.contains?(name, "..") -> {:error, :traversal}
        String.starts_with?(name, "/") -> {:error, :absolute}
        String.contains?(name, "\0") -> {:error, :null_byte}
        String.length(name) > 255 -> {:error, :too_long}
        not Regex.match?(~r/^[a-zA-Z0-9._\-]+$/, name) -> {:error, :invalid_chars}
        true -> :ok
      end
    end

    def resolve_safe_path(base_dir, filename) do
      candidate = Path.join(base_dir, filename)
      canonical_base = Path.expand(base_dir)
      canonical_candidate = Path.expand(candidate)
      if String.starts_with?(canonical_candidate, canonical_base <> "/") do
        {:ok, canonical_candidate}
      else
        {:error, :path_escape}
      end
    end
  end

  defmodule FileProcessor do
    @temp_dir "/tmp/file_service"
    @upload_dir "/var/data/uploads"

    def stage_file(content, filename) do
      File.mkdir_p!(@temp_dir)
      staging_name = Base.url_encode64(:crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16), padding: false)
      staging_path = Path.join(@temp_dir, staging_name)
      File.write!(staging_path, content)
      {:ok, staging_path}
    end

    def promote_staged_file(staging_path, target_filename) do
      target_path = Path.join(@upload_dir, target_filename)
      File.mkdir_p!(Path.dirname(target_path))
      # Verify staging_path is a regular file, not a symlink
      case File.lstat(staging_path) do
        {:ok, %File.Stat{type: :regular}} ->
          case File.read(staging_path) do
            {:ok, data} ->
              File.write(target_path, data)
            {:error, reason} ->
              {:error, reason}
          end
        _ ->
          {:error, :not_regular_file}
      end
    end

    def cleanup_staging(staging_path) do
      File.rm(staging_path)
    end
  end

  get "/health" do
    send_resp(conn, 200, "ok")
  end

  post "/api/v1/upload" do
    with {:ok, body, conn} <- Plug.Conn.read_body(conn),
         token when not is_nil(token) <- get_req_header(conn, "x-service-token") |> List.first(),
         {:ok, _service_id} <- Auth.verify_service_token(token),
         filename when not is_nil(filename) <- get_req_header(conn, "x-filename") |> List.first(),
         :ok <- PathValidator.validate_filename(filename),
         {:ok, _resolved} <- PathValidator.resolve_safe_path(@upload_dir, filename) do

      # Stage file first, then promote (two-phase write)
      {:ok, staging_path} = FileProcessor.stage_file(body, filename)

      # Validate staged file before promotion
      case validate_staged_file(staging_path) do
        :ok ->
          FileProcessor.promote_staged_file(staging_path, filename)
          FileProcessor.cleanup_staging(staging_path)
          send_resp(conn, 201, Jason.encode!(%{status: "uploaded", filename: filename}))
        {:error, reason} ->
          FileProcessor.cleanup_staging(staging_path)
          send_resp(conn, 422, Jason.encode!(%{error: reason}))
      end
    else
      nil -> send_resp(conn, 401, "missing auth")
      {:error, :invalid_signature} -> send_resp(conn, 403, "forbidden")
      {:error, :expired} -> send_resp(conn, 403, "token expired")
      {:error, reason} -> send_resp(conn, 400, "bad request: #{reason}")
    end
  end

  get "/api/v1/files/:filename" do
    with token when not is_nil(token) <- get_req_header(conn, "x-service-token") |> List.first(),
         {:ok, _service_id} <- Auth.verify_service_token(token),
         :ok <- PathValidator.validate_filename(filename),
         {:ok, resolved_path} <- PathValidator.resolve_safe_path(@upload_dir, filename) do
      # Use lstat to check the resolved path is not a symlink
      case File.lstat(resolved_path) do
        {:ok, %File.Stat{type: :regular}} ->
          case File.read(resolved_path) do
            {:ok, content} -> send_resp(conn, 200, content)
            {:error, :enoent} -> send_resp(conn, 404, "not found")
          end
        _ -> send_resp(conn, 403, "forbidden: not a regular file")
      end
    else
      nil -> send_resp(conn, 401, "missing auth")
      {:error, _} -> send_resp(conn, 403, "forbidden")
    end
  end

  defp validate_staged_file(path) do
    case File.lstat(path) do
      {:ok, %File.Stat{type: :regular, size: size}} when size > 0 and size < 10_000_000 -> :ok
      {:ok, _} -> {:error, :invalid_file}
      {:error, _} -> {:error, :stat_failed}
    end
  end

  match _ do
    send_resp(conn, 404, "not found")
  end
end
